rules.authentication: All routes except login, health and static files require an active authenticated session. Logout requires authentication only.
rules.read: Every protected GET/HEAD additionally requires view; permission_groups are AND groups, each group is OR.
rules.development_docs: GET /docs, /redoc, /openapi.json require authentication and view in dev; absent in prod (404).
rules.previews: POST analysis and preview routes read supplied data without saving; their declared read permissions are intentional.
rules.onboarding: GET /partner-onboarding/new only displays the start form. POST requires create or manage_reference_data and CSRF. Saving wizard steps requires create, edit or manage_reference_data; upload alone cannot create or change reference records.
rules.outlook: Authorization and callback additionally require edit or export (same permissions as preparing Outlook drafts).
rules.outlook_recovery: Manual reconciliation of pending/old drafts requires manage_system_settings, CSRF, expected_version and explicit evidence of the external result; it makes no Graph calls.
rules.legacy: User.role never grants access. Missing assignments require explicit reviewed assignment; inactive/deleted links must never be restored automatically.
rules.audit: Audit sections require audit_view; PSUR audit CSV requires both export and audit_view; sensitive audit fields require view_sensitive_audit.
rules.message_intake: Registration requires create; updates and linked case AE card edits require edit or icsr_workflow; duplicate searches require create, edit or icsr_workflow. All writes and duplicate searches require CSRF. Saving a new directory contact additionally requires create or manage_reference_data; creating an ICSR during handoff additionally requires create or icsr_workflow. Both message and linked case versions are checked; closed/submitted cases remain protected.
rules.package_review: Draft intake GET reads staged source values without creating records. Draft registration and selected-case confirmation require create or icsr_workflow and CSRF; they check batch version, input snapshot and each related case token. Source diagnostics, group availability and product matching still gate import. Import and intake changes commit atomically.
rules.integrated_clinical: Clinical and drug forms have declared create/edit permissions plus exact action checks at runtime. R3 plans require edit and additionally create for a new case. Source identity review requires icsr_workflow; R3 export and local AS2 require view and export, with icsr_workflow for preparation and dispatch.
